signal: REBA acquired market-data company Markerr in December 2025 to expand its multifamily analytics platform

email.body1:
Conner, saw REBA just acquired Markerr to expand your multifamily market data.

An acquisition like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover while you integrate the new datasets, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for REBA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Conner, quick follow-up for REBA.

Post-acquisition, the addressable market widens fast, but headcount rarely keeps pace. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to monetize the expanded platform, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings REBA needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Conner, last bit of proof for REBA.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how REBA's reply rate likely compares to other proptech analytics startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Conner, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after an acquisition, and I know integrating Markerr is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multifamily data motion? I will tailor it to REBA either way.
